in_hebrew.name: אראמנטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'aram' meaning 'exalted, high, mighty, strong' and 'anta' meaning 'one, only, unique'. Thus, Aramanta can be interpreted as 'Exalted, Majestic One' or 'The One who is Exalted and Majestic'.

in_greek.name: Αραμαντα
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'arama' meaning 'strong, mighty, warrior' and 'anta' meaning 'one, only, unique'. Thus, Aramanta can be interpreted as 'Strong One, The One and Only Warrior' or 'The Unique, Powerful Warrior'.

in_latin.name: Aramantia
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'arama' meaning 'exalted, high, mighty' and 'antia' meaning 'one, only, unique'. Thus, Aramanta can be interpreted as 'The Exalted, One and Only High One' or 'The Unique, Exalted One'.
